latestVersion.changelog:
Maker Editing Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered raw-to-edited video processing tool for content creators.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; exports polished 1080p MP4s in minutes.
- Automated backend connects via session/token with user-friendly status updates and error handling.
- Enables uploading, trimming, transitions, audio/text tracks, and exporting via simple prompts.
- Features session-based editing, quick or batch workflows, and robust feedback for unsupported files or limits.
